sections.title: Track and sliding thumb
sections.what: Draws the switch track, which changes colour for on or off, and the thumb that slides between the two positions.
sections.why: Likely reason: colour and sliding make the state easy to see.
sections.watch_out: The thumb moves a fixed distance, so changing the track width means the thumb distance must change too.

summary: Provides an on or off toggle switch.
purpose: Lets users turn a setting on or off.
why: Likely reason: it wraps a switch library for accessibility and applies the app's colours.
how: A rounded track changes colour for on or off, and a round thumb slides to the matching side. Extra props and style overrides pass through.
inputs: The checked state, a change handler, and a disabled flag.
outputs: A toggle that reports on or off.
risks: If the checked state is set without a change handler, the switch looks stuck.
debug: If the switch does not flip, check that the checked value and change handler are both connected.
